question: Chanakya had received his education at _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Taxila**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chanakya, also known as Kautilya or Vishnugupta, received his education at the ancient university of **Taxila**.
 
• Taxila was one of the oldest universities in the world, renowned for its education in various subjects including politics, economics, and military science.
 
• It is believed that Chanakya studied subjects like economics, politics, and war tactics at Taxila, which later influenced his works.
 
• Taxila, located in present-day Pakistan, was a prominent center of learning and attracted students from various parts of the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chanakya**

 
 
• He was an ancient Indian teacher, philosopher, economist, jurist, and royal advisor.
 
• Chanakya is traditionally identified as Kautilya or Vishnugupta, the author of the ancient Indian political treatise called the Arthashastra.
 
• He played a crucial role in the establishment of the Maurya Empire by helping Chandragupta Maurya overthrow the Nanda dynasty.
 
• His work, the Arthashastra, is considered a significant treatise on statecraft, economic policy, and military strategy.
 
 
 
• **Taxila**
 
 
• It was an ancient city that existed during the time of the Gandhara kingdom, around the 5th century BCE to the 2nd century CE.
 
• Taxila is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site due to its historical and archaeological significance.
 
• The university at Taxila offered courses in various fields such as medicine, law, military strategy, and the arts.
 
• Famous scholars like Panini, the Sanskrit grammarian, and Jivaka, the physician, were associated with Taxila.
 
 
 
• **Arthashastra**
 
 
• A comprehensive treatise on statecraft, economic policy, and military strategy authored by Chanakya.
 
• It is considered one of the earliest works on political philosophy and administration.
 
• The Arthashastra discusses topics such as governance, law, order, taxation, and foreign policy.
 
• It provides insights into the functioning of an ancient Indian state and the principles of effective governance.
 
 
 
• **Maurya Empire**
 
 
• Founded by Chandragupta Maurya with the guidance of Chanakya around 321 BCE.
 
• It was one of the largest and most powerful empires in ancient India, covering a significant part of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The Maurya Empire is known for its well-organized administration and military prowess.
 
• Emperor Ashoka, one of the most notable Mauryan rulers, played a key role in the spread of Buddhism.
